::: {.question-box}
What happens inside a potato under phosphate stress, and which genes sit behind a trait?
:::

During my MSc I worked through three classic kinds of analysis using established tools.
I'm now **rebuilding each one in my own code**, and each will get its own page as it's finished.

::: {.card-grid}
::: {.cute-card}
### Phosphate-stress transcriptomics

Potato microarray data (ArrayExpress E-MTAB-2990). Differential expression with **limma**,
then enrichment with **clusterProfiler**.
:::
::: {.cute-card}
### Peking duck GWAS

Genome-wide association with **PLINK** for quality control and **GAPIT3** for association testing.
:::
::: {.cute-card}
### Metagenomics

A microbial community project done together with a friend.
:::
:::

## Tools I used

::: {.chips}
[R]{.chip} [limma]{.chip} [clusterProfiler]{.chip} [PLINK]{.chip} [GAPIT3]{.chip}

## What I learned

::: {.learned}
- Running a tool and understanding it are different things. That's why I'm rewriting these analyses myself.
- Plant transcriptomics and GWAS are the areas I want to grow into.
:::
